title: cdpe: single-position simulator for the Collateralized Debt Position of Energy (Section 5 code)
description: Python package, scripts, tests and a walkthrough notebook that reproduce Section 5 (validation of a single position) of 'Collateralized energy positions for community battery storage: mechanism design and assessment': the log-OU spot process, the rate-limiting oracle with a 24-hour reference price, a single collateralized position with three liquidation triggers, the eight protocol invariants, the 500-trajectory price envelope, the permanent-shock sweep and the evening-discharge collateral channel.
